questions.question: What did the centurion say that impressed Jesus about his faith?
options: He offered Jesus a rich reward for healing his servant
He vowed to leave everything and follow Jesus at once
He said he was not worthy for Jesus to come under his roof
He asked Jesus to come and heal his whole household
questions.answer: He said he was not worthy for Jesus to come under his roof

questions.question: What did Jesus do when a great storm arose on the sea?
options: He swam quickly to the shore
He rebuked the winds and the sea
He prayed all through the long night
He walked out upon the water
questions.answer: He rebuked the winds and the sea
